commands.name: guard
commands.description: Show what tamirs-superpowers-guard holds and refuses, and both options' current values
commands.output:
tamirs-superpowers-guard — in-process holds on top of the bash guards (which stay canonical).

hold_destructive_commands: on
  A Bash call that force-pushes, deletes a branch with -D, removes a worktree with --force, resets --hard, cleans with -f, runs rm -rf outside a temp directory, or discards the working tree (git checkout -- . / git restore .) pauses in a Proceed/Cancel dialog. Cancel refuses it. Where nothing can draw the dialog (claude -p, the SDK) the call goes through unheld.
  This session: 1 hold, 1 cancelled; last: rm -rf outside a temp directory → cancel (rm -rf build && git push --force origin main).

deny_main_checkout_writes: on
  While an objective is active (SUPERPOWERS_OBJECTIVE_ID, or an objective.json with status active under .dev-files/objectives/) and this session sits in the main checkout rather than a worktree, an Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit inside the repository is refused with the objective's worktrees named. Writes under .dev-files/ and inside any agent worktree pass.
  This session: 0 writes refused.

Change either in /config (tamirs-superpowers-guard) or with `claude plugin configure tamirs-superpowers-guard`.

denies.tool: Bash: rm -rf build && git push --force origin main
denies.reason: tamirs-superpowers-guard: rm -rf outside a temp directory cancelled at the hold: rm -rf build && git push --force origin main
